description:
>>> 
# ✨ Get styled on! ✨
<<<

This cube was born from watching friends play Bracket 3 Commander and seeing someone build their deck around [[Fling]]ing a [[Jumbo Cactuar]] into someone’s face for 10,000 damage.

Making a deck whose win con is so committed into being flashy is the cube’s goal.


---

## 🤔 What to expect:
- **Win cons that play out similarly to Bracket 3 Commander games.**
- **Normal for people to draft 3+ colors.**
- **"BRO I SWEAR MY DECK IS A 7 (proceeds to play a Mox Diamond) 🙃"**
- **Supports up to 20 players in a single draft.**

---


## 🔎 Archetypes
- [Dual Archetypes](#dual-archetypes)
- [Mono Color](#mono-color)

---

## Dual Archetypes

---

### {W}{U} Blink {W}{U}
This cube started as an ETB cube, and it still kinda is. Even a little blink support makes most decks better. The best pickups are the cards that blink **nonland** permanents.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd]]
- [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]]
- [[Overlord of the Mistmoors]]
- [[!Brago, King Eternal|e4a2ef07-1afa-44a4-a3ed-41eeb8caccfc]]

---

### {U}{B} Theft {U}{B}
**“Show your opponent how fun their deck is when you play it for them”** 

Steal their best cards until their best draw is a basic land. A strong control shell that involves out-tempoing your opponent.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Extract Brain]]
- [[Fallen Shinobi]]
- [[Silent-Blade Oni]]
- [[!Thief of Sanity]]

---

### {B}{R} Artifact Sac {B}{R}
[[Weapons Manufacturing]] was the inspiration for Rakdos. Play non-token artifacts, then sac them for value.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Obsessive Pursuit]]
- [[Marionette Master]]
- [[Oni-Cult Anvil]]
- [[!Weapons Manufacturing]]

---

### {R}{G} Midrange Hell {R}{G}
Everyone has a plan until they take a turn 3 [[Overlord of the Boilerbilges]] to the chin. Most red high CMC creatures act as removal when they enter or attack. Ramping to it early enough will solidify a win.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Bloodbraid Challenger]]
- [[Doors of Durin]]
- [[!Roxanne, Starfall Savant]]

---

### {W}{G} +1/+1 Counters & Go Wide {W}{G}
Build a wide board, grow it with +1/+1 counters, then turn that spread of power into a flashy finish. Counter sources and token makers are the enablers; anthems, counter scalers, and go-wide finishers are the payoffs.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Silk, Web Weaver]]
- [[Wakka, Devoted Guardian]]
- [[Elspeth, Storm Slayer]]
- [[!Bristly Bill, Spine Sower]]
---

### {W}{B} Aristocrats Aggro {W}{B}
A blend of classic aristocrats with aggression, so opponents lose life whether they block or not.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER]]
- [[Lingering Souls]]
- [[!Assault Intercessor]]

---

### {U}{R} Non-combat damage {U}{R}
Find a way to do non-combat damage, double it, add to it, scale it. [[Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might]] like effects turn small bits of damage into a lethal turn.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Vivi Ornitier]]
- [[Coruscation Mage]]
- [[Weftstalker Ardent]]
- [[Solphim, Mayhem Dominus]]
- [[!Ghyrson Starn, Kelermorph]]

---

### {B}{G} Golgari Delirium {B}{G}
Fill up your graveyard, then bring it back.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Satyr Wayfinder]]
- [[Living Death|4ac29c46-f8ee-42ba-a98c-d785ba65485e]]
- [[Demolisher Spawn]]
- [[!Winter, Cynical Opportunist]]

---

### {W}{R} Boros Humans {W}{R}
The only supported tribe, and it’s easy to accidentally have 10+ Humans in your deck.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Lightning, Army of One]]
- [[Éomer, King of Rohan]]
- [[Thalia's Lieutenant]]
- [[!Winota, Joiner of Forces]]

---

### {U}{G} Simic +1/+1 {U}{G}
Efficient ramp, countermagic, and the best draw engines. Simic is the natural boogeyman of the game. Pray to your god that your opponent doesn’t find Nadu.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Bristly Bill, Spine Sower]]
- [[Edric, Spymaster of Trest]]
- [[Arwen, Weaver of Hope]]
- [[!Nadu, Winged Wisdom]]

---

## Mono Color



---

### {W} Stax {W}
Stumble your opponents before they get a chance to stabilize.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Thorn of Amethyst]]
- [[Thalia, Heretic Cathar]]
- [[!Thalia, Guardian of Thraben]]

---

### {U} Control {U}
Control your opponent, make them regret playing the cube.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Laboratory Maniac]]
- [[Talrand, Sky Summoner]]
- [[Kappa Cannoneer]]
- [[!Jace, Wielder of Mysteries]]

---

### {B} Aggro {B}
Black has been getting some real aggressive bombs recently, a 2 mana 4/1 and a few removal spells is game over.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Mai, Scornful Striker]]
- [[Drana, Liberator of Malakir]]
- [[!Sunset Saboteur]]

---

### {R} Red Deck Wins {R}
Pros win with it, now you can too.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Slickshot Show-Off]]
- [[Zurgo Bellstriker]]
- [[!Gau, Feral Youth]]

---

### {G} Chonkers {G}
Ramp into an indestructible 8/12.

**Cards to look out for:**
- [[Llanowar Elves]]
- [[Somberwald Sage]]
- [[!Zopandrel, Hunger Dominus]]
